channel.title: Mikhbar — English
channel.description: Technology news covering AI, robotics, automation, mobile, computing, software, the web and digital platforms.

item.title: Node 20 No Longer Available on GitHub Actions Runners
item.description: GitHub Actions runners have officially ended support for Node 20, transitioning entirely to Node 24 for JavaScript actions across environments.

item.title: NVIDIA Launches Nemotron 3 Diarization Open-Weight Model
item.description: NVIDIA introduces Nemotron 3 Diarization, a 100M-parameter open-weight model topping VoiceArena's leaderboard for real-time multi-speaker AI.

item.title: Use Open Weight Models With Amazon Bedrock for Coding
item.description: Pair open weight models with Amazon Bedrock and OpenCode for a secure, flexible, pay-per-use AI coding assistant without managing infrastructure.

item.title: NVIDIA Details Warp and MJWarp Robotics Workflows
item.description: Discover how NVIDIA Warp and MuJoCo Warp accelerate robotics simulation and learning workflows by scaling parallel environments on GPUs.

item.title: Ringg AI agents resolve 65% of calls using OpenAI GPT-5.6
item.description: Ringg leverages OpenAI GPT-5.6 to cut customer service costs by 90% and resolve up to 65% of inquiries across voice, chat, and WhatsApp channels.

item.title: Sakeena Fiza Drives NVIDIA Hardware Success at Scale
item.description: Discover how validation engineer Sakeena Fiza helps turn cutting-edge NVIDIA hardware into dependable infrastructure for the AI era.

item.title: OpenAI Academy marks two years with expanded community training
item.description: OpenAI Academy celebrates its second anniversary, launching new learning paths and a Community Trainer Program to bring AI skills to more communities worldwide.

item.title: OpenAI Extends Cyber Access to Ukraine for Defense
item.description: OpenAI announced it is extending access to its Daybreak program to the Government of Ukraine to support the cyber defense of civilian infrastructure.

item.title: Grab and OpenAI Launch GO Forward with AI in Southeast Asia
item.description: OpenAI and Grab have launched GO Forward with AI, a regional training program helping 30,000 partners build practical AI skills across Southeast Asia.

item.title: Critical F5 BIG-IP Zero-Day Vulnerability Exploited
item.description: F5 and CISA warn organizations about a critical F5 BIG-IP zero-day vulnerability being actively exploited by threat actors for remote code execution.

item.title: NVIDIA and Partners Highlight AI Advancements at Singapore Event
item.description: Discover how NVIDIA and regional partners are showcasing breakthrough AI advancements, open models, and public sector deployments across Southeast Asia.

item.title: GitHub Copilot App Adds OpenTelemetry Support
item.description: The GitHub Copilot app now supports OpenTelemetry configuration via enterprise-managed settings, letting organizations track agent activity and performance.

item.title: OpenAI Expands GPT-6 Series with Sol and Luna Models
item.description: OpenAI expands its GPT-6 universe by introducing Sol and Luna, two new cost-efficient models offering high performance across coding and professional tasks.

item.title: GitHub Announces Major Security Improvements for SSH
item.description: GitHub is removing several outdated SSH algorithms, adding a post-quantum key exchange method, and requiring larger RSA SSH keys for improved security.

item.title: Claude Opus 5.5 arrives in GitHub Copilot for agentic coding
item.description: Anthropic's newest Opus model is now available in GitHub Copilot, offering efficient agentic coding and knowledge work with usage-based billing.

item.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna Models
item.description: OpenAI has expanded its GPT-6 model family with the release of GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, bringing lower costs, higher efficiency, and better accuracy.

item.title: Claude Opus 5.5 Arrives on Amazon Bedrock and AWS
item.description: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 model is now available on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS, bringing advanced capabilities for agentic coding and knowledge work.

item.title: Googlebook Laptops Launch With Android Foundation
item.description: Googlebook introduces a new category of laptops built on Android, offering developers opportunities to scale apps with adaptive development.

item.title: Tata Elxsi Builds IRIS Industrial Safety Platform on AWS
item.description: Tata Elxsi developed IRIS, a real-time industrial safety platform on AWS, using computer vision to detect workplace risks in seconds.

item.title: Trane Technologies Cuts Diagnostic Time by 60x with AI
item.description: Trane Technologies has leveraged Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to reduce complex HVAC diagnostic workflows from 20 minutes to just 20 seconds.

item.title: Microsoft Disrupts EvilTokens Phishing-as-a-Service Platform
item.description: Microsoft's Digital Crimes Unit has disrupted the EvilTokens phishing platform, which compromised 12,000 accounts across 10,000 global organizations.

item.title: Chinese Hackers Exploit ZyXEL Switch Vulnerability
item.description: A Chinese threat actor has compromised nearly 1,000 ZyXEL switches worldwide, prompting CISA to add the vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list.

item.title: Windows Task Manager Creator Releases Modern TMOG Tool
item.description: Dave Plummer, the original architect of Windows Task Manager, has launched a cross-platform diagnostic utility built with the help of AI.

item.title: Adobe Premiere Mobile Arrives on Android Devices
item.description: Adobe has officially brought its mobile video editing application to Android, offering free core tools and optional AI-powered creative features.

item.title: New Mac mini and Mac Studio Launch With M6 and M5 Chips
item.description: Apple has officially released the new Mac mini and Mac Studio, featuring powerful M6 and M5 silicon, advanced AI capabilities, and enhanced performance.

item.title: Cloudflare Launches Worker Previews for Isolated Environments
item.description: Cloudflare introduces Worker Previews, providing developers and AI agents with isolated, production-like environments for testing code changes in parallel.

item.title: XPENG Iron Robot Walks Off Production Line After Assembly
item.description: XPENG’s new Iron humanoid robot has begun its journey toward mass production, successfully walking off the assembly line immediately after being built.

item.title: NVIDIA Launches Isaac ROS 5.0 to Advance Agentic Robotics
item.description: NVIDIA has released Isaac ROS 5.0, introducing new AI agent capabilities and open-source tools to accelerate physical AI development for robotics.

item.title: Meta Patches Zero-Day Vulnerability in Muse AI Desktop App
item.description: Meta has released a security patch for its Muse macOS application after a zero-day exploit allowed attackers to hijack the AI agent’s system privileges.

item.title: Polymarket Lobbies EU Regulators to Reclassify Operations
item.description: Polymarket is seeking to be regulated as a financial services provider rather than a gambling platform to bypass strict European restrictions.

item.title: Meta’s Pivot: From Metaverse Bets to AI-Powered Glasses
item.description: Meta is shifting focus from its struggling metaverse vision to AI-integrated smart glasses and new agents, despite ongoing regulatory and social challenges.

item.title: New Microsoft Defender Zero-Day Blocks Antivirus Updates
item.description: Security researcher Abdelhamid Naceri has released a new zero-day exploit dubbed BigDiskBuster that prevents Microsoft Defender from updating.

item.title: Hugging Face Transformers Now Supports llama.cpp GGUF Models
item.description: Hugging Face has added native support for GGUF model files to its Transformers library, enabling developers to run quantized AI locally.

item.title: GitHub Deprecates All-Platform CodeQL Bundle
item.description: GitHub has officially deprecated the all-platform CodeQL bundle, directing users to adopt platform-specific binaries starting with version 2.27.0.

item.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Seek Smaller Data Centers
item.description: As gigawatt-scale projects face development delays, OpenAI and Anthropic are pivoting to 20-30 MW data centers to secure immediate computing capacity.

item.title: How to Use AI Chatbots While Protecting Your Privacy
item.description: As AI usage grows, privacy risks mount. Discover how you can navigate the landscape of chatbots while keeping your personal data secure.

item.title: CISA Orders Federal Agencies to Patch Exploited Zyxel Flaw
item.description: CISA has added a high-severity Zyxel GS1900 series switch vulnerability to its KEV catalog, ordering federal agencies to patch it by Thursday.

item.title: Acer Launches New Promotions on Laptops and Gaming Gear
item.description: Acer is offering significant savings on hardware bundles and electronics, including discounts for students, military members, and healthcare professionals.

item.title: Google Launches Android-Powered Googlebook Laptop Lineup
item.description: Google is introducing its new line of Android-based Googlebook laptops on October 4th, featuring deep mobile integration and Gemini AI capabilities.

item.title: Does Apple’s Safari Browser Actually Protect iPhone Privacy?
item.description: Apple's Safari browser offers built-in privacy protections, but how effective are they? We examine the limitations and security realities of mobile browsing.
